mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_audit_log (operator_id, operator_type, operation, target_type, target_id, detail, before_val, after_val, client_ip, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{operatorId}, #{operatorType}, #{operation}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detail}, #{beforeVal}, #{afterVal}, #{clientIp}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, operator_id AS operatorId, operator_type AS operatorType, operation, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, detail, before_val AS beforeVal, after_val AS afterVal, client_ip AS clientIp, created_at AS createdAt FROM t_audit_log WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND operator_id = #{operatorId} AND operation = #{operation} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 0, 200
